TileStructure.Forest.density_tree_bound2.statement: (Lemma 7.3.1, second part) Let $f,g$ be bounded with compact support, with $\operatorname{supp} f\subseteq F$ and $\operatorname{supp} g\subseteq G$, and let $u\in t$. Then $$\Big\|\int_X\overline{g(x)}\,T_{\mathfrak T(u)}f(x)\,dx\Big\|\le C_{7.3.1.2}(a)\,\mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak T(u))^{1/2}\,\mathrm{dens}_2(\mathfrak T(u))^{1/2}\,\|f\|_{L^2}\,\|g\|_{L^2}.$$
TileStructure.Forest.density_tree_bound2.sketch: Combines the tree projection estimate (Lemma 7.2.1) with the local density bound Lemma 7.3.2 (local_dens1_tree_bound), using the support conditions on $f$ and $g$ and the definitions of $\mathcal J$, $\mathcal J_0$, parent cubes and dilated tiles to bring in the factors $\mathrm{dens}_1^{1/2}$ and $\mathrm{dens}_2^{1/2}$.

TileStructure.Forest.density_tree_bound1.statement: (Lemma 7.3.1, first part) Let $f,g$ be bounded with compact support, with $\operatorname{supp} g\subseteq G$, and let $u\in t$. Then $$\Big\|\int_X\overline{g(x)}\,T_{\mathfrak T(u)}f(x)\,dx\Big\|\le C_{7.3.1.1}(a)\,\mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak T(u))^{1/2}\,\|f\|_{L^2}\,\|g\|_{L^2}.$$
TileStructure.Forest.density_tree_bound1.sketch: Combines the tree projection estimate (Lemma 7.2.1) with the local density bound Lemma 7.3.2 applied on the cubes $L\in\mathcal L(\mathfrak T(u))$ to control the $g$-side projection by $\mathrm{dens}_1^{1/2}\|g\|_{L^2}$.

TileStructure.Forest.local_dens1_tree_bo.statement: (Lemma 7.3.2) Let $u\in t$ and $L\in\mathcal L(\mathfrak T(u))$. Then $$\mu\Big(L\cap G\cap\bigcup_{\mathfrak p\in\mathfrak T(u)}E(\mathfrak p)\Big)\le C_{7.3.2}(a)\,\mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak T(u))\,\mu(L).$$
TileStructure.Forest.local_dens1_tree_bo.sketch: Works with the parent cube of $L$ (Grid.succ), dilated tiles $\lambda\mathfrak p$ and their sets $E_2(\lambda,\mathfrak p)$, using the stronger Lemma 2.1.2 (Grid.dist_strictMono) to compare frequency distances, and concludes from the definition of $\mathrm{dens}_1$.
